title: Fourier coefficient under a matrix pushforward
statement: Let $H$ be an $m$-by-$n$ matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$, let $\varphi$ be a probability density on the $m$-dimensional binary cube, and let $\gamma$ be a point of the $n$-dimensional binary cube. The vector Fourier coefficient of the density obtained by pushing $\varphi$ forward under the map $y\mapsto yH$ equals the vector Fourier coefficient of $\varphi$ at $H\gamma$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a probability density on the $m$-dimensional binary cube
